How long should your title last?
One-time payment, no auto-renewal. Tier price × 3 months.

In chess, the letters before a name say who someone is — GM, IM, FM. A Nexus title sits in that same place, and everyone in every game, chat and leaderboard sees it.

It is not something anyone can pick up by playing more — it is only for the people who chose to keep this place running. If you hold a FIDE title, yours sits beside it: GM NS YourName.
